requirements: Confirm full candidate VIN/build and actual front hub manufacturer part / OE marking.
Independently check wheel bolt pattern, flange/offset, splines, hub mounting, brake shield and ABS sensor connector and pulse output.
Follow MY2006 Saab hub workshop instructions and renew the removed hub centre nut; secure correct replacement hardware.
Verify speed-sensor live signal, wheel-bearing noise/play, safe braking and wheel installation after repair.
parts.notes: Supplier-manufacturer FAG replacement is an aftermarket candidate for the NG 9-3 and also catalogued for Opel/GM families. It is not a demonstrated interchangeable used Opel hub or Saab-authorized OEM supersession; no tested longevity or current US supply/pricing claims.
